name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.4 Snapshot 3 R1)
description: Unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix and the 26.3 branch. Targets Minecraft 26.4-snapshot-3. Experimental snapshot port: basic world entry and pipeline compilation verified on macOS/Vulkan; gameplay, dedicated servers and optional integrations need further testing. Forge Config API Port 26.3.0 currently requires a Minecraft dependency override. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The 1.1.8 SemVer core preserves existing gun-pack version requirements.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
